content: Jesudi me niŋ wede hakinit tubukedebaguk
Jesu kweboboe bikabuŋa foune metam feedi bopneeŋ keletaugiŋ.
Kaŋ me niŋ wede hakinit adi wooŋ Jesu hebeŋ foloŋ mulelem timiŋa tubulodadok yoŋa indiŋ niŋguk, “Da nadilaŋ, nehitubu-lodawe kaŋ kedem nehitubu-kedebaweŋ.”
Unduŋ yobune Jesudi kaŋ kohoŋ kihiwali honeeŋ niŋguk, “Kedem nadigamulat ale walandaweŋ.”

Unduŋ nimbune nai uŋaniŋgoŋ folooŋ walandaguk kaŋ indiŋ niheguk, “Metam mu yenimbihileŋ. Siloŋyot diniŋ talitimeŋ’walaŋ didimeŋgoŋ weŋ kaŋ gabunadiwek. Kaŋ metamdi gabuŋa agaŋ kedebaŋaŋ unduŋ gabunadineŋdok weŋ, wooŋ koom Mosesdi yoguk unduŋ Bepaŋdok kale dumuŋ hemundumunduŋe timimbeŋ. Kaŋ nemek mintaŋak u kedem kaŋ nadineŋ.”
Jesudi tipilapilaye-mekuya niŋ yagit gineniŋ tubukedebaguk
Jesu adi Kafanaum yokwet maaneŋ folune mikme’walaŋ talitimeŋ niŋ adi buŋa Jesu indiŋ ninadiguk,
“Wapum, tipilapilaye-mene yagit malabumuŋ tiŋa folooŋ sumbandaune waliwali mu tiŋa folofigita kisaŋ hanadilak.”
Unduŋ nimbune Jesudi yoguk, “Nu kedem wooŋ tubukedebait.”
Unduŋ yobune mikme heki’walaŋ talitimeŋdi indiŋ tubu-udaneguk, “Wapum, nu me loloŋnit bale nu yotneneŋ weŋ. Kedem ale iŋgoŋ yali mede hogok yobeŋ kaŋ tipilapilaye-mene kedem kedebawek.
Nu na maaŋ me wapum diniŋ falipmeŋ hatilatdi mikme uneŋ yenimbe wiiŋ, be buneŋ yenimbe biiŋ, be tipilapilaye-meneye nemek u tineŋ yenimbene tiiŋ doktiŋa ganilat.”
Unduŋ yobune Jesudi mede u nadiŋa boho tiŋa metam keletaugiŋ indiŋ yeniŋguk, “Nu biyagoŋ hinek hanilat. Nu Isilaehi hidi’walaaniŋ nadisukiliti indiniŋ nemu kagut. Unduŋ doktiŋa indiŋ hanilat.
Metam fee kwetkwet mele labulabuneŋkade be mele fofoŋneŋkade buŋa bopneeŋ Abalaham, Aisak eŋ Jekop heki dut Bepaŋ’walaŋ Hatihati Kobuli gineŋ noŋgoŋ ila hinamuni tineeŋ.
Kaŋ metam koom netok yoŋa yabukahileguk iŋgoŋ mu nadisukilitimiiŋ adi yadi yeniŋkulune fakaŋ fooŋ mambip gineŋ hatiŋa kobulabulaye tiŋa masiŋkilip toyaneeŋ.”

Unduŋ yenindapmaaŋ mikme diniŋ talitimeŋ u indiŋ niŋguk, “Kedem ale weŋ, nadisukilitigedi nemek mintawek nadiŋaŋ undugoŋ hinek mintagambek.” Jesudi unduŋ nilune nai uŋaniŋgoŋ hinek tipilapilaye-meŋiŋ kedebaguk.
Jesudi metam fee yehitubu-kedebaguk
Kaŋ Jesu adi Pita yolineŋ looŋ kalune Pita yapmaŋ tam adi yagit tiŋa folooŋ kudup daune deihakuk.
Undiniŋ kaŋ kohoŋ foloŋ honeune kedebaguk. Tam u kedebaaŋ pilali Jesudok nanaŋe tiulidokomiŋguk.

Mele fohebilune metam yabaphinit fee yanagila bugiŋ, kaŋ Jesudi mede gineŋ hogok yeniŋkulune yabap heki meeniŋ biyabuŋa fooŋ bu utelegiŋ, eŋ metam noli yagit folofigitahinit u maaŋ yohoneeŋ yehitubu-kedebaguk.
Unduŋ tubune Polofet Aisaiyadi Bepaŋ’walaŋ maŋiŋ mede tagimneeŋ indiŋ yoguk u folooŋ mintaguk: “Negoŋ yagit folofigitanik bekudapmaguk.”
Jesu kelekeledok medeŋiŋ
Metam mohok feedi buŋa Jesu kelemadiune yabuŋa mihiŋiyedi muwage neeŋ tiŋa buune ime fokolok loloŋdok yeniŋguk.
Kaŋ uuŋdok yatulune Yodoko Mede henale niŋdi Jesu hebeŋ foloŋ wooŋ niŋguk, “Henale, nu du dambedambek waaŋ kaŋ wondok tuwot gehikeleyawaat.”
Unduŋ yobune Jesudibo niŋguk, “Kamo moiŋ heki adi kawade ginaneŋ ikiiŋ eŋ bagi heki adi yohineŋ ikiiŋ, iŋgoŋ Me Kobumuŋ adi hakula titiŋdok kweli nemoŋ.”
Kaŋ mihiŋiye’walaaniŋneŋ niŋdi niŋguk, “Wapum, nadiune timeŋ wooŋ batne wenefulaŋa bit.”
Yobune Jesudi indiŋ niŋguk, “Dabaŋ u biune dabahi noliyedi wenefulaneŋ, du yadi buŋa nu nehikeleweŋ.”
Fifiŋgobutdi Jesu’walaŋ maŋiŋ mede tagimneguk
Unduŋ yoŋa muwage foloŋ loune mihiŋiye maaŋ noŋgoŋ looŋ ila ugiŋ.
Ulune fifiŋgobut wapum tubune ime giyondaaŋ buŋa muwagehik gineŋ foguk. Kaŋ Jesu adi damo hadeikuk.
Ala mihiŋiyedi Jesu talamsukuleeŋ indiŋ niŋgiŋ, “Wapum, indi agaŋ ime gineŋ wopmabutne tam ale pilap nihitubu-lodaluweŋ!”
Nimbune sukuleeŋ yeniŋguk, “Munta maŋgoŋde tiiŋ. Hidi nadisukilitihik maŋgoŋde gilaŋgilaŋ tilak?” Unduŋ yeniŋa pilali yali sububa dut ime yenintoŋa yeniheune gitagoŋ kulemaaŋ hakumuk.
Kaŋ mihiŋiye adi u kaŋ boho tiŋa indiŋ yogiŋ, “Me i dediniŋgoŋ doktiŋa sububa dut imedi medeŋiŋ nadiyamuk?”
Jesudi meyat lufom’walaŋ yabap yehikelekuyemguk

Jesu adi imeŋgwaŋ fukuniŋ Gadalahi’walaŋ kwetneŋ wosuwaguk. Wosuwaune meyat lufom yabaphinit meyotneŋ hakumukdi fooŋ bumiŋgumuk. Meyat u fafaŋe gibita tagumuk doktiŋa metam adi utalik woŋambuŋat mu tagiŋ.
Ala Jesu kaŋ yakawe toŋa indiŋ niŋgumuk, “Bepaŋ mihiŋiŋ, du maŋgoŋ tinimbe bulaŋ? Nai mu tulune deti folofigita kwanai gehiŋgehiŋ nimbeŋ?”
Kaŋ makaye mohok kweetniŋgoŋ-kabe uŋgoŋ yabudokooŋ heyemagiŋ.
Ala yabap hekidi Jesu nimbulabulayeeŋ indiŋ ninadigiŋ, “Niniŋkule kaŋ niniŋkulune looŋ makaye welehik maaneŋ fonim.”

Unduŋ yogiŋ kaŋ Jesudi yeniŋguk, “Fooŋ buŋa wiiŋ!” Yenimbune adi meeniŋ gineniŋ fooŋ buŋa looŋ makaye welehik maaneŋ fogiŋ. Kaŋ makaye heki kigoŋkula wooŋ maham gineŋ tatakula ime gineŋ fooŋ ime naaŋ nadilali kumuŋgiŋ.
Kaŋ me makaye yabudokoyagiŋ hekidibo momoŋ yokwet wapumneŋ looŋ makaye heki’walaŋ kahat eŋ meyat yabaphinit yakat’walaŋ kahat u metam wanakaŋ tiyemdapmagiŋ.
U tiyembune nadiŋa metam hogohogok wanakaŋ faŋkalap tiŋa Jesu kanene fogiŋ. Fooŋ kaŋ kwehik u bikabuŋa uuŋdok niŋgiŋ.
